notes.title: New VR Adventure Game Release!
notes.content:
Hello VR Fans,

We’re excited to share our new adventure game, Tomb Explorer VR! If you're interested in this exciting VR title, mark your calendars for the August 1 release. Check out our trailer, screenshots below.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33702081/0b9808660bde17c78d0da579bfb9f53afa48b5f5.jpg

TOMB EXPLORER VR

Tomb Explorer VR is an adventure game where you navigate/explore ancient ruins and tombs in search of historical treasures, relics and artifacts.

Features:
In a fully immersive physical virtual reality experience, you will need to utilize various physical movements such as walking, crouching, jumping, climbing, dodging, sliding, rope zip lining, and even using a whip to hang over ledges to navigate through each unique environment. The ultimate goal is to solve puzzles, unlock ancient mechanisms, avoid dangerous traps, and discover hidden passages to obtain valuable artifacts located all around the globe.

Experience real-life physical interactions in VR, using your hands, body movement, and weapons to crouch, jump, climb and navigate through different environments. Overcome various ancient traps that hinder you from completing your objective. Use your problem-solving skills to solve puzzles and explore new areas. Each unique environment comes with a historical background story.
